I believe we have helper functions for this exact case that should be used.  If you can't use them, please articulate why in your commit message.
Changed this one to just get the managed host object paths and then go from there. Let me know if that's okay.
Please read and understand common error #12 in the bmcweb docs.  Use the appropriate structures.

Reworked this to use Olek's systems utils to get the managed host object paths, then look for the intersection with the paths that the software is associated with.

That way there's an exact match and no imprecise matching.
This isn't guaranteed to be the path, right?  The software could be at any depth in this tree.

Its as per the latest documented design. The PDI definition also defines this object path to be the namespace for software inventory.

https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/code-update.md

Anyways, not relying on it will make the code better.

Passing the object path through now since there was some call further up which already fetched it.
Thanks for looking into this patch 😊

The name of this function implies it would find the single system instance as well but it is only looking for the multi-host ones. Seems like a different name would be better.

I.e. getSystemCollectionMembers() fills in for the single instance. But this one isn't going to return any D-Bus paths for the single instance.
agree, it could be confusing. Renamed it to `getManagedHostPaths`
nit: Could use std::ranges::find() instead for cleaner looking code.
Thanks! applied it.

Can the subtree search be limited by searching "/xyz/openbmc_project/software" instead?
I see the interface defines that as the path: https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/e4a64ba768a675937bcb41c5e74098c26de1d5e2/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Software/Version.interface.yaml#L68C18-L68C47
That does not work, as we are not looking for software versions but e.g. computer systems. Changed it to look in the `/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory` namespace.

Can any interfaces be specified?

Should it be "xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item"? The design document specifies that is the connection. (https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/code-update.md#association)

I cannot use `xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item` since EM has a bug in 

https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/100db08b8201539ddee6ba6ac2c19177e7af6df1/src/entity_manager/entity_manager.cpp#L137

```
    std::shared_ptr<sdbusplus::asio::dbus_interface> inventoryIface =
        dbus_interface.createInterface(
            boardPath, "xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item", boardName);
```

notice that `inventoryIface` has no further references so the shared_ptr is decremented when it goes out of scope.

The interface is still stored in `objServer` somewhere but it is never initialized like the other interfaces.

observed this on yv4 qemu

```
root@yosemite4:~# busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/Yosemite_4_Sentinel_Dome_T1_Slot_3
NAME                                                 TYPE      SIGNATURE RESULT/VALUE                             FLAGS
org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable                  interface -         -          
org.freedesktop.DBus.Peer                            interface -         -                                        
org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties                      interface -         -                                        
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset        interface -         -                                        
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Revision     interface -         -                                        
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Slot         interface -         -                                        
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.Board             interface -         -                                        
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.Board.Motherboard interface -         -                                        -
```

And we cannot just look for managed host interface either because the related item is not necessarily a computer system.

It's just the specific case i am implementing here.

The related item could be something else like Voltage regulator. Which represents a case someone could expand there in the future.

I believe we are on the safe side here because in any case we construct a correct redfish URI for the system.

Let me know if it's still an issue.
Thank you for looking into this 👍
#include <algorithm>
Done
Won't BMC, other inventory items also have this association ?

Right, you have a point there.

Since in the single host path there is nothing representing the redfish ComputerSystem on DBus, we cannot just add this association without any backing.

If we were to just a generic `RelatedItem` for the computer system, we should probably add it in other places too, which would cause a lot of overhead.

I removed it for now. We can base the `RelatedItem` on the associations.

Can this be swId like elsewhere?
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/f8ae88768e33c050d08aeac6a0a657043de27407/redfish-core/include/utils/sw_utils.hpp#L84
sure, i adjusted it throughout the patch for consistency 👍
Isn't this the inventoryPath ? Like https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/83945

yes, i had the wrong variable name :/

Fixed it.

don't you need to look for certain interfaces ?
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/f8ae88768e33c050d08aeac6a0a657043de27407/src/dbus_utility.cpp#L130

yes, sure.

Adjusted it to pass an array `relatedItemInterfaces` to constrain our search.
Thanks for reviewing, made some adjustments based on the feedback 👍

Hi, thanks for this idea and code sample, i changed the code to match 👍

The equivalent manual call to what i used is

```
busctl call xyz.openbmc_project.ObjectMapper /xyz/openbmc_project/object_mapper 
xyz.openbmc_project.ObjectMapper GetAssociatedSubTreePathsById ssassas 
HostSPIFlash_8456 /xyz/openbmc_project 1 xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version 
"running" 1 xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.ManagedHost
```

and i had to constrain to `/xyz/openbmc_project` instead of `/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory` or `/xyz/openbmc_project/software`. Since the Managed Host and Software are on different namespaces, the call apparently requires i choose the common parent namespace.

Also re-tested the change.
It looks good to me - with a minor comment
Is it better to add `ec` to debug log?
Done 👍.

`ec` would be sufficient as it will show both 'value()` & `message()`.
I think also, it is better to combine 2 debug entries into one.

```
BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG("Could not get associated managed hosts, ec = {}", ec);
```
Nice, i did not know it would do that. Fixed it now 👍

Similarly, it is better to combine 2 debug entries into one.

```
    BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG(
        "Could not find related Chassis items for {} by association, ec={}", swId, ec);
```
Done. Thanks for pointing out everything in need of changing 👍
